# DBCorp — Design Build Corporation

> DBCorp is a design-build firm in Islamabad, Pakistan. One team designs houses, gets the building plans approved, builds them and finishes the interiors, from an empty plot to handing over the keys.

## Key facts

- Not to be confused with: D B Corp Ltd, the Indian media company (Dainik Bhaskar). DBCorp in Pakistan is a separate, unrelated business.

- Name: DBCorp (Design Build Corporation)
- Based in: Islamabad, Pakistan
- Builds in: DHA Islamabad, Bahria Town Islamabad/Rawalpindi, CDA sectors (D, E, F, G, I), Gulberg Greens, B-17 Multi Gardens, Rawalpindi, Lahore and Karachi
- House sizes: 10 marla plots up to multi-kanal estates
- Contract model: one contract covering design, approvals, construction and finishes; payments tied to construction stages
- Contact: +92 313 555 8245 (call or WhatsApp), Instagram @dbcorp.pk
- First step: a free 10-minute call about the plot, the process and a realistic budget range

## Services

- Architecture and design: bespoke house design drawn to the plot and the society's rules, with 3D renders
- Building plan approvals: drawings prepared and submitted to CDA, DHA, Bahria Town or the governing society
- Turnkey construction: foundation to finishes, with material grades written into the contract
- Luxury interiors: stone, millwork and lighting specified and installed by the same team
- Grey structure and renovation: structural work and renovations held to new-build standard

## How a DBCorp project runs

1. Site visit: walk the plot (sun, access, levels, neighbours, society rules)
2. Brief: a written room-by-room brief and a budget band
3. Design and render: floor plans and a 3D render
4. Approvals: full drawing set submitted to the governing authority
5. Contract: one quote priced against the approved drawings, with stage-linked payments
6. Structure: foundation, columns and slabs, with photo and video updates
7. Finishes: glazing, stone, millwork and lighting
8. Handover: final walk-through, snags closed, keys and as-built drawings handed over
